_comment: Smriti Bolna agent template. scripts/create_agent.py sends agent_config + the prompt in prompts/smriti_agent.md to POST /v2/agent (or PUT /v2/agent/{id} with --update). It overrides webhook_url and task_config.call_terminate from .env. smriti_markers is NOT sent to Bolna: the segmenter uses it to split the transcript into tasks. language_variants: overrides applied by create_agent.py --language kn|en (one agent per STT/TTS language). check_user_online_message replaces Bolna's English default ('Hey, are you still there') with the call's language; every welcome message also ends with a question so the person answers straight away. hangup_after_silence is 40 s: on the first live calls the first transcript took up to ~26 s to arrive. Provider/model names verified against bolna.ai/docs on 2026-10-30.

declined: We will not do the check today

agent_config.agent_welcome_message: नमस्ते! मैं स्मृति बोल रही हूँ, आपके परिवार की ओर से। क्या आप मुझे ठीक से सुन पा रहे हैं?

task_config.call_cancellation_prompt: End the call only when the assistant has just said its final goodbye of the memory check: the closing lines after the last question, the goodbye after stopping because the person was upset, or the goodbye after the person declined. Do not end the call during the tasks, even if the person is silent, unclear, or says a greeting or goodbye-like word while answering.
task_config.check_user_online_message: क्या आप मुझे सुन पा रहे हैं?

kn.agent_welcome_message: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ! ನಾನು ಸ್ಮೃತಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯವರ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನನ್ನ ಮಾತು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿಸುತ್ತಿದೆಯಾ?

en.agent_welcome_message: Hello! This is Smriti, calling on behalf of your family. Can you hear me clearly?

multilingual._comment: Used by create_agent.py --multilingual: one agent with Hindi, Kannada and English. Every call starts in English (user_data.agent_language = en): the greeting asks which language to speak, and Bolna switches speech recognition, voice and replies together when the caller names a language or speaks one.

welcome_messages.hi: नमस्ते! मैं स्मृति बोल रही हूँ, आपके परिवार की ओर से। आप किस भाषा में बात करना चाहेंगे: हिंदी, कन्नड़ या इंग्लिश?
welcome_messages.kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ! ನಾನು ಸ್ಮೃತಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯವರ ಕಡೆಯಿಂದ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ನೀವು ಯಾವ ಭಾಷೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತಾಡಲು ಇಷ್ಟಪಡುತ್ತೀರಿ: ಕನ್ನಡ, ಹಿಂದಿ ಅಥವಾ ಇಂಗ್ಲಿಷ್?
welcome_messages.en: Hello! This is Smriti, calling on behalf of your family. Which language would you like to speak: English, Hindi or Kannada?

kinds._comment: create_agent.py --kind checkin|family: the same voice stack, multilingual, with its own prompt, welcome lines and limits. The call starts in user_data.agent_language.

welcome_messages.en: Hello! This is Smriti, your family's AI companion, calling for our weekly chat. Is this a good time?
welcome_messages.hi: नमस्ते! मैं स्मृति हूँ, आपके परिवार की AI साथी। हमारी हफ़्ते वाली बातचीत के लिए फ़ोन किया है। क्या अभी बात करना ठीक रहेगा?
welcome_messages.kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ! ನಾನು ಸ್ಮೃತಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯವರ AI ಸಂಗಾತಿ. ನಮ್ಮ ವಾರದ ಮಾತುಕತೆಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಈಗ ಮಾತಾಡೋಕೆ ಸರಿಯಾಗುತ್ತಾ?

checkin.call_cancellation_prompt: End the call only right after the assistant has said its final goodbye (for example 'Talk to you next week. Take care!'), or after the person asked to stop and the assistant said goodbye, or after someone else answered and the assistant said goodbye. Never end the call in the middle of the conversation, even if the person is quiet or says something like 'okay' or 'that's all'.

welcome_messages.en: Hello, this is Smriti, calling with an update about your family. Is this a good time to talk?
welcome_messages.hi: नमस्ते, मैं स्मृति हूँ। आपके परिवार के बारे में एक जानकारी देने के लिए फ़ोन किया है। क्या अभी बात कर सकते हैं?
welcome_messages.kn: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು ಸ್ಮೃತಿ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನೆಯವರ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಒಂದು ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಕೊಡಲು ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೇನೆ. ಈಗ ಮಾತಾಡಬಹುದಾ?

family.call_cancellation_prompt: End the call only right after the assistant has said its final goodbye ('Thank you ... Take care.'), or after the wrong person answered and the assistant said goodbye. Never end the call in the middle of the conversation.
